title: GlossMark ontology file
description: A *.gloss.yaml ontology: one namespace's concepts and relation declarations. Mirrors model.Ontology, model.Concept, model.Published and model.RelationDecl in internal/model. Concept keys that are not structural attributes are relations (produces, consumes, constrains, ...) whose targets are concept names or CURIEs.

namespace.description: The CURIE prefix of this namespace; may repeat the key under owns: in glossmark.yaml.

iri.description: IRI base of the namespace (normally taken from glossmark.yaml).

tier.description: Ontology tier. An owned file defaults to owns.<prefix>.tier; an importer reads it before imports.<prefix>.tier. gloss publish writes it.

concepts.description: Concepts keyed by PascalCase name. A concept with no body (null) is allowed and treated as empty.

relations.description: Relation declarations or overrides, keyed by relation name. A known builtin is tuned field by field; an unknown name creates a new concept→concept relation usable in ontology files.

symbol.description: In code, the first line that assigns, annotates or defaults it. In YAML, TOML or JSON, a dotted key path (policies.claims-write.per_minute), or a key or tail of one that ends exactly one path.

target.description: A relation target: a bare concept name in this namespace (Item), a CURIE (lib:Media), or for some relations a CURIE glob (circ:Catalog*).

stringOrList.description: A single string or a list of strings (model.StringList).

nodeType.description: One of the five node types of the metamodel.

published.description: Marks an implementation concept as crossing into the business view under a core concept's name (model.Published).

as.description: The core concept (CURIE) this concept surfaces as.

concept.description: One ontology entry (model.Concept). Known structural keys are typed; every other kebab-case key is a relation whose value is a target or list of targets. gloss check requires kind unless the concept has is-a.

label.description: Human-readable label; defaults to the concept name.

is-a.description: Taxonomic parent(s). Stored as direct edges; the closure is computed.

part-of.description: Partonomy: the whole(s) this concept is part of.

realizes.description: Core concept(s) this implementation concept realizes.

internal.description: Private to this repository; never shown in the business view.

replaced-by.description: Concept that supersedes a deprecated one.

value.description: A documented attribute value (for example a measure's current value). Any YAML value.

shapes.description: Reserved for SHACL-style instance validation (Phase 3). Any YAML value.

value-from.description: The code a published value comes from: one location, or a list when the value is duplicated (an API and a page). A change to any of those lines without a change to value is a HARD published-value drift.

proposed.description: The entry is a proposal (the ontology's @gloss?): it exists so links resolve, and a human accepts it with gloss accept --concept.

proposed-by.description: Actor that proposed the entry, e.g. agent:claude-code@model.

planned.description: The concept is specified and nothing implements it yet (docs/adr/0025-deriving-the-ontology.md 6.1, docs/adr/0034-ontology-first-increments.md). true, or { by: YYYY-MM-DD, ticket: <uri> }, both optional: by is the inclusive deadline after which drift reports plan-overdue; ticket is provenance the tool never reads. Out of coverage and orphans; a plan item in gloss drift until the first implements or represents link reaches it, then planned-closed until gloss accept --planned drops the key. Allowed on core and implementation concepts.

aliases.description: Other names people and agents use; search_concepts matches them.

criticality.description: Governance level of the concept (docs/GOVERNANCE.md). Implementation concepts inherit the highest level of what they realize when unset.

^(?!(?:kind|label|doc|is-a|part-of|has-p.description: A relation (produces, consumes, publishes, subscribes, constrains, guards or its alias applies-to, reverses, attaches-to, or one declared under relations:) and its target(s).

relationDecl.description: How an ontology file declares or tunes a relation (model.RelationDecl). Only the fields set are applied over the builtin.

lift.description: How gloss drift summarizes a boundary's derived set for this relation: range-lcs (the builtin default for produces, consumes, publishes and subscribes) shows it by its least common subsumer, none shows the members. Coverage is not affected: a declared supertype always covers a derived subtype (ADR 0011).
